color_semantics.vibrant_green: Healthy leaf tissue with normal chlorophyll synthesis (450-520nm absorption).
color_semantics.pale_yellow_chlorotic: Loss of chlorophyll due to nitrogen/iron deficiency, viral chlorosis (e.g., Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl), or fungal halo toxification.
color_semantics.brown_black_concentric: Necrotic cell death forming concentric bullseye rings characteristic of Alternaria solani (Early Blight) and Target Spot.
color_semantics.dark_olive_water_soaked: Rapid cellular breakdown from Phytophthora infestans (Late Blight), often accompanied by white fluffy sporangiophores in high humidity.
color_semantics.bright_yellow_orange_pustules: Fungal spore accumulation of Puccinia rust species breaking through leaf epidermis.
color_semantics.white_powdery_ash: Surface epiphytic mycelium and conidia of powdery mildew (Erysiphales).
color_semantics.scorched_brown_margins: Vascular blockage, bacterial blight (Xanthomonas), or marginal scorch from drought or heat stress.
color_semantics.yellow_green_mottle_curling: Viral systemic disruption causing leaf lamina deformation and stunting (Begomovirus / TMV).

Apple___Apple_scab.color_clues: Olive-green to velvety brown or black spots on leaves, becoming puckered and distorted.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_treatment: Apply liquid copper or sulfur sprays before bloom. Rake and burn fallen leaves in autumn.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75 WP or Captan 50 WP during primary infection periods.
Apple___Apple_scab.outbreak_risk: High (rain and high humidity trigger spore release)

Apple___Black_rot.color_clues: Small purple spots enlarging into 'frogeye' leaf spots with light brown centers and dark purple borders.
Apple___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Prune out dead wood and mummified fruit where fungus overwinters.
Apple___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Captan or Thiophanate-methyl applications from petal fall.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.color_clues: Bright yellow-orange or red spots on upper leaf surface, followed by tiny black dots (pycnia).
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic_treatment: Remove nearby eastern red cedar trees if possible; spray sulfur early spring.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.chemical_treatment: Myclobutanil or Propiconazole at 7-10 day intervals starting at pink bud.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.outbreak_risk: High (wind carries spores up to 1-2 km from alternate host)

Apple___healthy.color_clues: Rich green coloration, smooth margins, unblemished surface.
Apple___healthy.organic_treatment: Maintain balanced compost, proper mulch, and regular pruning for aeration.

Cherry___Powdery_mildew.color_clues: Circular patches of white powdery fungal growth on leaves, leading to upward curling.
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.organic_treatment: Spray wettable sulfur, potassium bicarbonate, or 5ml/L neem oil.
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.outbreak_risk: Moderate (warm dry days followed by cool humid nights)

Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.color_clues: Rectangular, brown to gray necrotic lesions strictly delimited by leaf veins.
Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.organic_treatment: Crop rotation with non-host crops and deep tillage of crop debris.
Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.outbreak_risk: High (spreads rapidly during warm, overcast, humid days)

Corn___Common_rust.color_clues: Oval to elongated cinnamon-brown pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Corn___Common_rust.organic_treatment: Plant rust-resistant hybrids; avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer.
Corn___Common_rust.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb or Propiconazole if pustules appear before tassel emergence.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.color_clues: Large, cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions (2.5 to 15 cm long).
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic_treatment: Resistant cultivars, crop rotation, soil incorporation of old stover.

Corn___healthy.color_clues: Deep emerald green parallel venation, sturdy leaf blade, no discoloration.
Corn___healthy.organic_treatment: Standard organic manure and balanced NPK nutrition.

Grape___Black_rot.color_clues: Small circular reddish-brown spots with dark borders on leaves with tiny black pycnidia.
Grape___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Thorough dormant pruning; remove mummified berries from vine canopy.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb or Myclobutanil early season applications.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).color_clues: Interveinal chlorosis and necrosis creating a distinctive 'tiger-stripe' pattern.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic_treatment: Protect pruning wounds with wound sealants; sanitize pruning shears.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).chemical_treatment: No curative chemical; remove infected wood cleanly below canker.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).color_clues: Asymmetric blotchy yellow mottle on leaves, yellow shoots, hard bitter fruit.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic_treatment: Control Asian citrus psyllid with neem and horticultural oils; eradicate infected trees.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).chemical_treatment: Target psyllid vector with systemic Imidacloprid or Thiamethoxam.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).outbreak_risk: Critical (quarantine pest that destroys entire orchards)

Potato___Early_blight.color_clues: Dark brown circular spots with concentric target-board rings on older foliage with yellow chlorotic halo.
Potato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Copper hydroxide spray; ensure adequate potassium nutrition; avoid overhead watering.
Potato___Early_blight.outbreak_risk: High in warm fluctuating wet/dry conditions

Potato___Late_blight.color_clues: Large, irregular water-soaked dark lesions on leaf tips, white fungal down underneath.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Copper sulfate + lime (Bordeaux mixture); immediately rogue out initial infected plants.
Potato___Late_blight.outbreak_risk: Epidemic (can destroy a 2ha potato field within 72 hours)

Potato___healthy.color_clues: Compound dark green foliage, no necrotic spots or leaf roll.
Potato___healthy.organic_treatment: Earth up hills, maintain moisture balance, use certified seed tubers.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.color_clues: Small (less than 3mm) dark brown, water-soaked circular spots with yellow halos.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Copper bactericide mixed with Bacillus subtilis bio-control; avoid working in wet fields.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Copper Oxychloride + Streptocycline (100 ppm) bactericide spray.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.outbreak_risk: High (splashing rain and overhead irrigation spread bacteria)

Tomato___Early_blight.color_clues: Concentric ring 'bullseye' brown spots on lowest leaves, surrounded by yellow tissue, progressive leaf drop.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Mulch soil surface, spray neem extract (10,000 ppm), stake plants, remove lower 30cm leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.outbreak_risk: High (spores survive in soil debris for over a year)

Tomato___Late_blight.color_clues: Greasy, dark greenish-brown lesions expanding rapidly, white fungal growth on leaf reverse.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Prune infected branches immediately in dry weather; spray preventive copper soap.
Tomato___Late_blight.outbreak_risk: Critical (airborne spores travel 5-10 km on cool humid winds)

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.color_clues: Pale green or yellow spots on upper leaf surface with olive-green to brown velvety mold underneath.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic_treatment: Improve greenhouse/polyhouse ventilation, keep relative humidity below 85%.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.color_clues: Numerous small circular spots with gray or tan centers and dark brown margins; tiny black speck pycnidia inside.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic_treatment: Remove diseased bottom leaves, deep mulch, 3-year crop rotation.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.chemical_treatment: Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb applied every 7-10 days.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.color_clues: Fine yellow stippling/speckling on leaf surface, fine silken webbing on leaf undersides, bronzed dried leaves.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic_treatment: Release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis), insecticidal soap spray, neem oil.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.chemical_treatment: Abamectin 1.9% EC or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC miticide.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.outbreak_risk: High in hot, dry, dusty conditions

Tomato___Target_Spot.color_clues: Small pinpoint brown lesions expanding into circular lesions with light brown centers and dark concentric rings.
Tomato___Target_Spot.organic_treatment: Space plants for air circulation; avoid wetting leaves during watering.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.color_clues: Severe upward cupping and curling of leaf margins, yellow chlorotic leaf edges, reduced leaf size, bushy stunted plant.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic_treatment: Yellow sticky traps (15 per acre), fine mesh netting (50-mesh), neem spray to suppress whitefly vectors.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical_treatment: Control whitefly vector Bemisia tabaci with Acetamiprid 20% SP or Spirotetramat.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.outbreak_risk: Critical (whiteflies transmit virus within 15-30 minutes of feeding)

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.color_clues: Alternating light and dark green mosaic patterns on foliage, distortion, 'shoestring' leaf effect.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic_treatment: Wash hands with milk or soap before handling plants; discard infected plants, do not smoke near crops.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical_treatment: No chemical cure exists; plant ToMV resistant varieties.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.outbreak_risk: High (mechanically transmitted on tools and hands)

Tomato___healthy.color_clues: Even dark green foliage, vigorous growth, crisp serrated margins, no chlorosis or spots.
Tomato___healthy.organic_treatment: Balanced vermicompost, regular trellising, consistent drip irrigation.
